name: omp-dashboard
description: One dashboard page for the omp coding agent: API-equivalent spend over 24h to 30d with provider, model and agent-type breakdowns; live usage limits for every logged-in account with bell alerts at 90%; and a tally of every subagent run with a live transcript inspector. Reads omp's own stats database and session files, read-only.
author: tommy
highlights: Overview: spend tiles for 24h, 3 days, 7 days and 30 days, a 14-day spend strip, the limits closest to running out and what the agents are doing now
Spend: API-equivalent cost by provider, model and agent type, with cache-hit rate, time to first token and tokens per second
Limits: one row per limit across every provider account; amber from 75% used, red from 90% or exhausted
Bell notification once per limit and reset window at 90% and when a limit is exhausted, even with no dashboard tab open
Agents: every omp subagent by type with OK rate, cost and timeline, plus a live transcript inspector for any run
A composer chip shows the busiest limit and tints amber from 75%
useCases: See what omp is costing at list price before a bill or a quota runs out
Notice that a 5-hour or weekly limit is about to be exhausted before an agent session stalls on it
Watch a long-running subagent without leaving the dashboard
configuration: Requires the omp CLI on the machine running Kiro Crew, with its stats database at ~/.omp/stats.db and sessions under ~/.omp/agent/sessions; enable the app and open OMP Dashboard from the sidebar.
Override locations with OMP_BIN, OMP_DASHBOARD_STATS_DB and OMP_DASHBOARD_SESSIONS_DIR if omp keeps its data elsewhere.
